a96d11edfa6b: Export a book as USFM (aligned or plain) · translationCore 4 Help
f94a9df0cb10: USFM is the standard text format for Bible translations.
1e94ef8ceb99: Click Export (1), then USFM, aligned (2) or USFM, plain.
db946efab3d8: USFM, aligned includes your links to the original language, for tools that read alignments. Align the verses first. See Link your words to the source.
dd38b1bfdf16: USFM, plain is just your text.
ffb0917a26ef: A joined verse span is written as one verse, for example \v 2-3.
46717a73e9ca: The header lines (\h, \toc1–\toc3, \mt) contain the book code, such as TIT, not the book name. Edit them if another program needs the name.
1d6a4dcee725: USFM, aligned writes the alignment of each verse whose alignment is up to date. A verse that needs review is written without its alignment, and the panel says Your alignment of these verses is not in the file and lists them. Review those verses in Align and export again. The next export clears the message.
8e797de8362c: Verses you imported with alignments are written exactly as they were imported.
d7ba70e5d6d8: USFM, plain and PDF never include alignments, so they never show this message.
44afc7d304ce: Saving over a file that already exists replaces it without asking. Choose a new file name if you want to keep the old file.
caf999f3879c: Community Checking with the Export menu open. Export is marked 1, and USFM, aligned is marked 2; USFM, plain is just below it.
